acceptance: Capture versioned real EXPLAIN outputs for the seven listed parser families using existing supported local/service test routes; add captured fixtures alongside synthetic fixtures and update provenance only for engines actually exercised.

For each family, validate at least scan/filter, join and aggregate shapes, plus a branching/compound shape where supported; assert table/operator/child semantics and round-trip fingerprint integrity, not only non-empty output.

Live CI selection distinguishes actual executions from credential-based skips and records engine/version evidence; unavailable credentials or infrastructure remain an explicit incomplete validation outcome.
Preserve deterministic no-credential fixture coverage and keep live-cloud execution behind explicit authorization; do not provision paid services merely to close this item.
context: Assessment on 2026-10-28 ran 1176 focused tests successfully but no external live services. This item tracks missing real-engine semantic assurance, not an asserted failure of all listed parsers. Prior completed validation items explicitly allowed hooks/bookkeeping without provisioning engines. Full validation requires authorized access; do not mark synthetic fixtures live-validated from unit-test success.
description: Plan parser coverage is broad but much of it is synthetic or mocked. PROVENANCE.md still marks Presto/Trino, ClickHouse, Spark, Databend, QuestDB, Doris and SingleStore as not live-validated. Existing optional live hooks generally exercise SELECT 1 and assert a root and stable fingerprint, which does not establish join, aggregate or branching semantics. Earlier completed items added provenance and hooks; extend those patterns with actual versioned engine output and semantic checks rather than treating their closure as live-validation evidence.
